snippet.title: Jessica Webb Quartet
snippet.description:
Official YouTube channel of the Jessica Webb Quartet — Kansas City jazz. Transcription material for students, masterclass clips, and live quartet performances. Led by tenor & alto saxophonist Jessica Webb, founder of Crossroads Conservatory of Music.

Lessons and enrollment: crossroadsconservatory.com
Band & booking: jessicawebbquartet.com

Business inquiries: jessica.webb@finthesiss.ai
